skill.name: appie-article-writer
skill.description: Write short light articles or long deeply-researched articles with Appie.run Content Writer. Use when the user asks to write an article, generate a blog post, create deeply researched content, draft in an author voice, or check article status. Triggers include write a short article, deeply researched piece, blog post about, generate content in my voice, article status.
skill.summary: Generate articles through Appie.run with author voice selection, credit awareness, and asynchronous status tracking.
skill.author: appierun

security_audit.summary: All 25 static findings are false positives: Markdown formatting, intended service URLs, and article identifiers do not demonstrate execution or reconnaissance. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent in SKILL.md. The workflow uses an authenticated external service, consumes credits, and explicitly prohibits sharing API keys in chat.

content.user_title: Generate Appie Articles in Your Author Voice
content.value_statement: Article workflows require author setup, format selection, and generation tracking. This skill coordinates Appie.run tools to create articles and retrieve completed content.
actual_capabilities: Request light articles of approximately 500 words or deeply researched articles of approximately 3000 words through Appie.run.
List authors, create author profiles, and add writing samples to support a chosen author voice.
Clarify ambiguous topics and article types before starting generation.
Track asynchronous generation by article identifier and return the exact article content supplied by the service.
Inspect brand context and update it only when the user explicitly requests changes.
Report author readiness errors, insufficient credits, and generation failures.
limitations: Requires a connected Appie.run MCP server and a project API key configured outside chat.
Generation consumes service credits: the skill lists 100 credits for light articles and 500 for deeply researched articles.
An author profile must exist and be ready before article generation succeeds.
Depends on external service availability and output; it provides no independent fact verification or guaranteed completion time.

use_cases.title: Draft Regular Blog Posts
use_cases.description: Generate a light article on a defined topic using an existing author profile, then retrieve the completed text.

use_cases.title: Commission Longer Articles
use_cases.description: Request a deeply researched article, confirm the credit cost, and track generation until the service returns content.

use_cases.title: Align Content With Brand Voice
use_cases.description: Create an author profile with approved writing samples and inspect brand context before generating campaign articles.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Light Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a light article about [topic] using my active author. State the credit cost before starting and return the completed article.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create a short article with an existing author.

prompt_templates.title: Check an Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the status of article [article ID]. Return the exact completed content when available, or report its current status.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: retrieve an existing generation result.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up an Author Voice
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an author named [name] with this biography: [at least 50 characters]. Add this approved writing sample: [at least 100 characters].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare a new author profile.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Brand Article
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect my brand context without changing it. List ready authors and let me choose. Then generate a deeply researched article about [topic]. Confirm cost first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine brand review, author selection, and long article generation.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: start a light article about indoor gardening when the service returns article identifier 123.
output: Generation is running in the background. I can check its status.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: create a deeply researched article when the service reports insufficient credits.
output_examples.output: A deeply researched article costs 500 credits. The service reported insufficient credits. Generation was not started.

best_practices: Configure the project API key in your MCP client, never in chat.
Confirm the topic, author, article type, and credit cost before starting generation.
Use approved writing samples and review returned articles for factual accuracy before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential biographies, writing samples, or brand information without authorization to share them with Appie.run.
Do not restart a pending article without checking its identifier and status; another generation can consume additional credits.
Do not treat generated articles as independently verified research or replace missing service output with invented text.

faq.question: What must I connect before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect the Appie.run MCP server with your project API key in your client configuration. Do not paste the key into chat.

faq.question: Which article formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents light articles of approximately 500 words and deeply researched articles of approximately 3000 words.

faq.question: How many credits does generation cost?
faq.answer: The skill lists 100 credits for a light article and 500 for a deeply researched article. Generation incurs the charge.

faq.question: Can I use my own author voice?
faq.answer: Yes. Create an author with a biography of at least 50 characters. Optional writing samples need at least 100 characters.

faq.question: Does the article appear immediately?
faq.answer: No. Generation is asynchronous. The skill tracks the returned article identifier and checks status until content or a final result appears.

faq.question: Does the skill verify research or change brand settings automatically?
faq.answer: It returns service content without independent fact verification. Brand context updates require an explicit user request.
